caption: TARGET MOCKUP · ILLUSTRATIVE DATA
initialBasePrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized game screenshot target. Create a high fidelity future gameplay SCREENSHOT MOCKUP for Ribterra version 0.26.1, landscape 16:9, preferably 1920x1080 or larger. This is a production visual target for implementation agents, NOT evidence of a real game build. The attached image is a STYLE AND HUD COMPOSITION REFERENCE, not a requirement to reproduce its out-of-scope fortress.
ART: handcrafted painterly pre-rendered 2.5D medieval alpine village, fixed orthographic 2:1 isometric ground, view downward about 30 degrees, no horizon or perspective vanishing point, no photoreal camera blur. Detailed timber framing, blue slate roofs, cut stone foundations, frosted conifers, layered irregular river banks, readable cold blue snow and warm amber window light. Dense enough to feel alive but only modest village scale, 10 readable residents. Coherent consistent light from upper-left. World occupies center and most of image.
WORLD LOCK FOR SERIES: river runs from upper-left along the left edge toward lower-left, ONE flat water level, modest stone/wood footbridge left-middle crossing the river. Low rock shelf and accessible gentle ramp upper-left, no huge mountain cutaway. Central compact settlement: stockpile at center foreground, two houses to the right, workshop upper-center, sawmill left-center by river, simple camp/fire near middle, farmhouse and small fenced empty winter field at upper-right, small mill/kitchen background. Small mine entrance on upper-left rocky shelf. Thick conifer groups around outer edges, natural clearing between buildings. NO built road system: only irregular local dirt/snow apron immediately around entrances, open snow terrain between buildings. No grid of connected streets, no stone road network. No castle, monumental temple, statue, city walls, tower defense, giant monsters, army, horseback/cart transport or large populations.
HUD LOCK: elegant illustrated navy-charcoal panels, subtle material grain, thin aged brass trim and beveled corners, ivory Ukrainian serif headings with very legible sans-serif numbers/body. Resource capsule at upper-left about 32% width; top-center FOUR weather forecast tiles for today/tomorrow/+2/+3 days; separate current Celsius badge beside them; real-condition alert upper-right; bottom-left COMPACT selected stockpile card about 31% width with thumbnail and one button; bottom-center FOUR buttons; bottom-right minimap with only explored area and viewport plus pause/speed/menu. Leave center open. Buttons at comfortable readable size. No massive right sidebar, no full-width two-row spreadsheet HUD.
SCENE: winter daytime, light snow cover, no falling snow right now; current -8°C, approaching snowstorm in 8 game hours. Stockpile selected with fine cyan outline; three residents visibly carrying actual logs/stone sacks toward it. No decorative cargo bars on every person.
Exact limited Ukrainian text: top resources "Wood 340" "Stone 180" "Food 260" "People 10"; forecast headings "Today" "Tomorrow" "+2 days" "+3 days", temps "-8°" "-12°" "-6°" "-3°"; temperature "-8°C"; alert "Storm in 8 hours" and smaller "Gathering and construction will slow down"; selected card "Stockpile" and "Occupied 86 / 5000", button "Open inventory"; actionbar "Build" "Gather" "Assign" "Cancel"; minimap controls "II" "1×" "2×". These are illustrative UI fixture values, not balance promises. No Fuel or Insulation panel; no unlock padlocks, combat resources or debug text.
A tiny quiet bottom-edge footer outside interactive elements must read "RIBTERRA · 0.26.1 · TARGET MOCKUP". Professional polished game UI, crisp typography, clear structure, not poster, not comparison collage, not a web page. Single full-screen frame.
